summary: Lays out children in a row with a token gap and wraps them when space runs out: badges, button rows, metadata.
whenToUse: Rows of related small items: badges, tags, buttons, meta text.
justify="between" for page and card headers: title at the start, actions at the end.
wrap={false} only when the row must stay on one line and can scroll or truncate.
whenNotToUse: Columns that must line up across rows: use Grid or Table.

dos.title: Let rows wrap
dos.text: Wrapping keeps every item reachable at narrow widths and at 200% zoom.

donts.title: Fixed widths inside an Inline
donts.text: Fixed widths fight the wrap and overflow on phones. Let content size the items.

accessibility: A plain div by default; use render for a list (<ul />) when the items are a list.
Wrapping never reorders items, so the visual and tab order match.
contentGuidelines: Not applicable: Inline holds no copy of its own.
